name: VOX Explainer Motion
author: Willy
description: Five VOX-style explainer motion graphics: kinetic headline, big stat count-up, data bar grow, lower-third reveal, pull quote. Off-white paper, ink black, yellow accent, red alert, Inter display.

items.name: Kinetic Headline
items.desc: VOX kinetic headline: word-by-word pop, keyword highlighted with accent block sweep.

items.name: Big Stat Count-up
items.desc: VOX big stat: animated count-up, accent underline sweep, source line.

items.name: Data Bar Grow
items.desc: VOX data chart: bars grow with staggered ease, one bar in alert color.

items.name: Lower-Third Reveal
items.desc: VOX lower-third: accent bar grow + name/role mask wipe. Default transparent overlay.

items.name: Pull Quote Highlight
items.desc: VOX pull quote: word stagger, keyword highlighted with accent sweep, citation.

props.quote: We have never seen a squeeze like this before.
